descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences In Ind As 38 Vis-À-Vis As 26
descriptors.definition: The comparative framework highlights key divergences between reporting standards, specifically noting that Ind AS 38 removes certain use-related restrictions from asset definitions and introduces explicit identifiability criteria based on separability or legal rights. These regulatory distinctions alter how entities recognize and evaluate intangible assets compared to previous Indian GAAP frameworks.
exclusion: General recognition criteria outside the scope of comparison
Detailed measurement rules of tangible assets
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between Ind AS 38 recognition thresholds and legacy AS 26 requirements regarding separability and probable future economic benefits.
